verdict.rationale: Telemetry opt-out is a fair question for a SaaS platform like Lorikeet, but the evidence pack documents no user-facing control to disable telemetry or usage tracking. The nearest items are adjacent and do not count: zero-data-retention agreements with model vendors and no fine-tuning on customer data (data-handling commitments, not a tracking opt-out), and opt-out handling for outbound customer messaging (end-customer consent, not product telemetry).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
